Yeah, that's true. Well, you can listen to a lot of the old recordings and just see where all of that came from. Well, there was a drummer, Roy Brown? I'm not sure. He's still around today too. Maybe I'm using the wrong name, but back in the late '40's he wrote a song, and the titled -- used the word rocking in it. And in fact -- I may be wrong again -- 'There's Good Rockin' Tonight' or something like that.
Yeah, yeah. Yeah, way back then.
